notes: No state rows. pepsico.com hosts a 2024 U.S. economic impact page (pepsico.com/about/economic-impact) and a PDF ('PepsiCo_2024_US-impact.pdf') that web search describes as an Oxford Economics study with state-level results; neither could be read, because pepsico.com's Imperva bot protection returned 403 / 'Access denied, Error 15' to curl, WebFetch and a headless browser on 2026-11-23. Its contents are unverified and nothing from it is recorded; a run from a normal browser may be able to add a company-commissioned state set. The 10-K gives ~319,000 employees with ~134,000 in the U.S. (US country row) and no other country or state split. Item 2 lists significant properties by division without counts by state or country; 12 of its 18 rows are used as sites (Russia plants, Israel, Vallejo, Colonia and Singapore omitted).
